sections.title: Performance Analysis
1. N+1 Query Patterns
`analytics.ts:113-115` — Posts array filtered once per platform (O(P×N))
`simulation-agent.ts:592-603` — Baseline simulation runs inside the sensitivity loop
`causal-graph-builder-agent.ts:508-528` — O(N³) confounder detection
`causal-graph-builder-agent.ts:192` — `queue.shift()` inside BFS is O(N)
2. React Re-renders
sections.content:
No React code exists in this codebase — this is a TypeScript agent/backend system. Not applicable.

---

sections.title: 3. Caching Opportunities
`hashtag-analyzer.ts:86-88` — `recommendHashtags` re-scores all static hashtags on every call
`simulation-agent.ts:321-322` — `simulationCache` is set but only used for `runSimulation`
`causal-graph-builder-agent.ts:430-431` — `graphCache` is written but never read
`analytics.ts` — `getAnalyticsCache()` exists but analytics functions don't use it
4. Memory Leaks
`orchestrator-agent.ts:135` — `taskQueue` grows indefinitely
`memory-agent.ts:127-130` — `VectorStore` grows without capacity bound
`simulation-agent.ts:321` and `causal-graph-builder-agent.ts:301` — unbounded `Map` caches
sections.content: Both `simulationCache` and `graphCache` are raw Maps with no eviction. As noted above, replace with the existing `LRUCache<T>` with a `maxSize`.

sections.title: `memory-agent.ts:413-451` — `consolidateMemory` is O(N²) and runs at shutdown
5. Redundant Computations
`analytics.ts:65-84` — 7 separate passes over the same data
`simulation-agent.ts:239-260` — `calculateMetrics` creates 4 sorted copies of 10K-element arrays
`simulation-agent.ts:266-276` — `calculateRiskScore` re-derives the mean already computed in `calculateMetrics`
`causal-graph-builder-agent.ts:237-248` — `getAncestors` scans full adjacency on every DFS step
`memory-agent.ts:258-260` — Two `sqrt` calls instead of one
Priority Matrix
sections.content:
| Finding | File | Severity | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline re-simulated in sensitivity loop | `simulation-agent.ts:592` | **High** | Low |
| Posts filtered per platform in report | `analytics.ts:113` | **High** | Low |
| `taskQueue` never evicts completed tasks | `orchestrator-agent.ts:135` | **High** | Low |
| `VectorStore` unbounded memory growth | `memory-agent.ts:127` | **High** | Medium |
| `recommendHashtags` not memoized | `hashtag-analyzer.ts:86` | Medium | Low |
| `graphCache` written but never read | `causal-graph-builder-agent.ts:430` | Medium | Low |
| 7 passes in `analyzePlatform` | `analytics.ts:65` | Medium | Low |
| 4 sorted copies in `calculateMetrics` | `simulation-agent.ts:239` | Medium | Low |
| O(N²) `consolidateMemory` at shutdown | `memory-agent.ts:413` | Medium | Medium |
| `getAncestors` linear adjacency scan | `causal-graph-builder-agent.ts:237` | Medium | Medium |
| O(N³) `identifyConfounders` | `causal-graph-builder-agent.ts:508` | Medium | High |
| `queue.shift()` O(N) BFS dequeue | `causal-graph-builder-agent.ts:192` | Low | Low |
| Duplicate sqrt in cosine similarity | `memory-agent.ts:258` | Low | Trivial |
